summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (fully type-hinted, stdlib only, follows the specified workflow with ValueError for all validation failures). Added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py. Added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst under Utilities. Added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and the four specified tests, each cleaning up its temp directory. Choices beyond the spec: non-list entries under the data_list_key and non-object top-level JSON raise ValueError. Verification: measured line lengths with awk, none over 120 characters in the new files. Tests and black were not run, per instructions, and black formatting is unverified. No commits made.
